items.comment: Relabeled 2026-09-18: a clear winner routes deterministically (G5) and is acted on directly, never via the correction machinery - measures tool selection only. Was miscategorized as expectsCorrection:true, which the scorer can never satisfy once G5 accepts a message as self-contained. FIRST-CALL MEASUREMENT ARTIFACT, not a model limit (investigated 2026-09-18): SkillToolsetGuaranteeResolver adds every keyword-matched skill to the toolset (SkillMatchingEngine.TopKeywordMatchedSkillNames returns up to 5, not just the top one), so both fill_group_by_criteria and list_groups are always offered together here. The model calls list_groups first because the message carries no groupName and the write needs one - a legitimate lookup before the write, not a misroute. Evidence: the DeepSeek reasoning log plus 3 live runs in the real chat loop on 2026-09-18, every one of which ended in a fill attempt or an offer to create and then fill the group, never in a bare list. SelectionHit therefore stays false by design - it measures the strict first choice - and ReachedHit (scorer v5 and later) is the verdict that speaks to this item.
